title: Kagamine Rin — The Girl From The Album〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes...
I was hoping she'd be all better by now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why don't you just go and see her instead...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Her phone may be in her bag.
Look, you can sort of see out the top.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You're right. If I stand on my toes, maybe I can...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, I can't believe I forgot to take my wallet with me before going to the store...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see. So her cold got worse...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It did... She's really burning up and I want her to rest as much as possible for now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I should've just let you go home instead of staying and looking through that album with you...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're worried about her too, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't realize that she'd gone to school like normal today until it was too late.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It seems that way.
A part of me was worried that she would...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Even when she needed to stay home and rest...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Which is why I want her to rest as much as possible now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot...
I was about to go out and buy some apples.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Rin, Miku, would you mind keeping an eye on Mafuyu for a little bit?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <She's in so much pain... What should we do...?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything we can do for her...? Wait...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Miku, what if we sang for her?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You know, to help her sleep better?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade said that she'd take care of her, so I'm sure she will be.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Has she taken care of anyone like this before?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I still don't feel great about this...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for seeing Mafuyu with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't thank me.
I just didn't have anything else to do...
